description: The bounds are reported, never a silent drop. A subscription that vanished looks exactly like a filter that matches nothing.

data.what: connection conn-1 already holds 32 subscriptions, which is the per-connection limit
data.means: the daemon bounds subscriptions per connection and in total; an unbounded registry on a daemon meant to run for weeks is a leak with a client-shaped cause
data.todo: unsubscribe what is no longer needed, or widen one filter instead of opening many subscriptions
